mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of tightening periods (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment rates (UNRATE < 4.5%) are associated with strong labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and simultaneously, the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 2.5% YoY, the combined effect predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in late-cycle expansions, a rise in RSAFS (retail sales) above $750B indicates sustained consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in late-cycle expansions with rising RSAFS (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the spread between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (inflation rate) being above 1.5% indicates a monetary policy supportive of growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a drop in UNRATE below 4.0% within a 3-month window signals an exceptionally strong labor market, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher following such UNRATE drops (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO is above its 6-month moving average and PAYEMS (non-farm payroll) shows growth above 150K jobs per month, the combined signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met.
